## Appearance

Rogerson is a small beauty with hazel eyes. She has long brown curls.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

Rogerson is described as being mean and horrid, despite her attractive appearance.

## History

Rogerson was a middle-aged Sunday-school teacher who taught her class for twenty years. Her relative, Prillie Rogerson, was brought home to live with her father after he remarried and fetched Prillie from her grandmother's house in Grafton. During one of her classes, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) attended and later criticized the lesson Rogerson taught as dry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P3](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XI.
